field_mapping_evidence.record_base: 0x57BC58; 0x57BCD8 is record0+0x80, the settings half. Therefore old +0x40..+0xBF maps to record1+0x00..+0x7F, the next player's player/company names.
field_mapping_evidence.names: unnamed character-select confirmation procedure 0x4C7B22..0x4C7B4C writes the player name to record0+0x00; 0x4C7B6D..0x4C7B87 writes the enterprise name to record0+0x40. FreePlaySetup_InitWindow reads them at 0x4CBD4F/0x4CBD60 and copies the whole 0xC0-byte record for the preview at 0x4CBD81.
field_mapping_evidence.characteristics: free-play UI labels 'Initial capital:' and 'Characteristics:' for each record; record+0x80 is the capital percentage, record+0x84 is the characteristic adjustment. Game_InitScenario 0x4821B4..0x482327 applies abs(+0x84) random +/-1 changes to the six Player character values (+0x3C..+0x50), each kept within -3..3; negative +0x84 applies -1, positive applies +1. AI players only.
field_mapping_evidence.character_values: CharacterSelect labels Buyer/Gangsters/Specialist/Politicians/Seller/Guard at controls 0x411..0x416, values at 0x418..0x41D; SubStartMenu 0x4C7B65 copies 0x57DD48.. to record+0x88..+0x9C; Game_InitScenario 0x482144..0x482187 copies to Player +0x3C..+0x50; CompanyOverview 0x4BD750 renders 'Character values:' with Base/Extra/Total columns at 0x2332..0x234D.
